title: Pairwise Reflection Symmetry in Generalized Latin Rectangles
summary: Many combinatorial designs ask for equal distribution of given symbols across the entries of a matrix. The paramount examples are Latin squares, where each symbol from $\{1,\dots,n\}$ appears once per row and column of an $n\times n$ matrix. Generalized Latin rectangles extend this to $λn \times n$ matrices with repeated symbols under controlled column frequencies. In this more general setting, we examine structural properties of pairwise reflection-symmetry, which requires that, on every pair of columns, each ordered symbol pair $(p,q)$ occurs as often as its reversal $(q,p)$.
